blocks.html: Matrix works well as your unit's primary messaging tool. This is a recommended way to structure your rooms — treat each room like a radio channel.

slides.title: Easy primary messaging tool
slides.html: Matrix fulfils all messaging and video-call needs well. All members of this server are automatically members of your server's Space, so you can start communicating with your team immediately.

slides.title: A good room structure
slides.html: In addition to the automatically created rooms, we recommend creating the following rooms and inviting the appropriate members. The core idea is to think of rooms as radio channels.

slides.title: Command room
slides.html: Invite your team leaders to the Command channel. It works like a radio command channel — for orders and their acknowledgements. It can also be used for briefings over video conference.

slides.title: Friendly situation room
slides.html: Invite at least your team leaders and deputies to the Friendly situation room. Use it to communicate the execution of your mission — where friendlies are moving and how task execution is progressing.

slides.title: Recon room
slides.html: Invite at least your team leaders and deputies to the Recon room. Use it to communicate reconnaissance and enemy observations.

slides.title: Guard room
slides.html: Set up the Guard room so that anyone can freely join from the Space. Operators starting guard or patrol duties join for the duration of their task, giving the command post a direct line to them.

slides.title: Other room recommendations
slides.html: Other recommended rooms include a Call for Fires room and a Fires Management room for fire direction and fire coordination.

slides.title: User management
slides.html: A user set as an administrator in Deploy App automatically receives administrator rights to the Space and its rooms, and is added to the admin room. A user removed from Deploy App loses access to Matrix.

slides.title: Working with other Matrix servers
slides.html: By default, you can invite users from other Matrix servers to your rooms. This enables cooperation with other teams using Deploy App, or with NATO allies who also use Matrix — for example through the NI2CE application.
